notes.title: Patch 1.0.11 Released
notes.notes: This build includes more updates for the Memory minigame, including a new skip button ("Avoid this Fate"). The button was added in case the player runs into the rare Memory minigame softlock bug so they can continue playing. Happily, it also allows for a new gameplay mechanic where everyone can weigh the risk of playing the Memory game for boon cards against getting cursed cards. Enjoy, travelers!

notes.title: Version 1.0.10 Released!
notes.notes: This version includes a couple of performance tweaks, plus some asset cleanup in the Memory mini-game. Enjoy, travelers!

notes.title: Update 1.0.9 Released!
notes.notes: This version includes bug and performance fixes, plus a fix for a potential exploit in curse selection.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 Released
notes.notes:
This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements, including:


 Faster load time for game boards
 Updated launch icons
 Fix for background music sometimes not looping properly
 Fix for events that could sometimes offer a duplicate card from an extra suit
 Fixed a typo in the displayed formula for scoring weakened curse cards

notes.title: Release 1.0.7
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where clicking a Freeze card would not reliably unselect previously selected cards.

notes.title: Release 1.0.6
notes.notes: Released a small patch today to fix an issue with the display of leaderboards.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Notes
notes.notes: Fixed a possible exploit in the "memory" minigame that allowed players to peek at each card before selecting it in matches.

notes.title: Curses of Tarot release day is set!
notes.notes: Curses of Tarot, the poker and tarot themed card game, will release on January 11, 2022. Wishlist today!
